page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g8i server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz.

The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance. For network connectivity, it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource distribution, the ecs.g8i.2xlarge offers a stable performance profile for workloads that require consistent compute power without the resource sharing typical of burstable instances. The 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for standard business applications, mid-sized web servers, containerized microservices, and general-purpose development or testing environments.
